ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics app coordinating volunteer drivers to group and transport local seniors to medical appointments and community events.
ideas.title: Seattle Non-Profit Volunteer Carpool Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses clear measurable social impact for Seattle-area non-profits with a demo that actually works live.

ideas.pitch: A real-time inventory platform helping Seattle food banks and shelters broadcast surplus supplies and automatically match them with nearby organizations in need.
ideas.title: Donation Inventory & Supply Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on immediate operational efficiency for local charities, making it extremely easy for judges to see tangible utility.

ideas.pitch: A localized web assistant offering multi-language access to Seattle community clinic schedules, vaccine clinics, and wellness resources.
ideas.title: Multilingual Community Health Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles real accessibility hurdles in diverse Seattle neighborhoods with a working, localized interface.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight reporting portal that aggregates grant milestones and local community metrics into simple, shareable visual dashboards for Seattle philanthropic boards.
ideas.title: Community Grant Impact Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a major administrative pain point for local non-profit directors who spend excessive time on compliance reporting.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal item-matching portal designed for local community centers to log found equipment, lost educational assets, and shared facility resources.
ideas.title: Non-Profit Lost Item & Resource Locator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features advanced multimodal matching that provides a technically impressive live demo well-suited for a weekend timeframe.
